title: Geometric Interpretation of Sum Photon Blockade
summary: We present a geometric interpretation of the sum photon blockade effect in multimode quantum optical systems, such as semiconductor microresonators. The blockade condition \(c^{(n)} \cdot v = 0\) reflects the orthogonality of the \(n\)-photon amplitude vector to a target mode vector in an \(N\)-dimensional Hilbert space, visualized as the confinement of the state to a hyperplane.
